goal: Compare sizes - bigger / smaller, biggest / smallest - by laying one thing on another (the bigger sticks out all around) and use it to act: wellies that fit, the big stones across a brook, a hat that fits.
cover: Fox in big yellow wellies and Squirrel in small ones stand on big stones in a shallow brook, rain drops around them; Owl in a red bobble hat and a striped scarf waves from under an old oak.
